url.description: Exact public HTTP(S) URL to read. Use web_search first when the URL is unknown.

query.description: Optional topic or section selector. Omit for the complete extracted main content.

view.description: Extraction view. main is the readable default; outline returns structure; raw preserves source-oriented text.

items.description: JSON property name or dotted field path.

fields.description: Structured JSON projection. Each returned collection item remains one complete object with these fields.

itemOffset.description: Zero-based item offset for a structured JSON collection. Reuse the same URL and fields.

itemLimit.description: Maximum structured JSON collection items. Use with itemOffset for item pagination.

maxChars.description: Explicit content bound. Omit for a full read. If it binds the result, use the reported nextContentOffset.

contentOffset.description: Continuation offset reported by a prior direct read. Keep the same URL and options. Do not invent this value or combine it with linked crawling.

refresh.description: Bypass a fresh traffic-cache hit and validate the canonical source again. Conditional validation can reuse unchanged canonical content.

path.description: Relative .md path below the private WebX export directory. WebX returns the absolute saved path.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file atomically. Default: false. Set true only when replacement is intended.

save.description: Save one extracted page as UTF-8 Markdown and return compact file metadata instead of the body. Not compatible with structured JSON projection or linked crawling.
